tests.given: Six supplied representative type vectors and six nonnegative coefficients summing to one.
tests.expect: The output equals the source weighted sum.

tests.given: A coefficient is negative or the coefficient sum differs from one.
tests.expect: A coefficient-contract error and no partial profile.

tests.given: No type center or alpha-estimation method is supplied.
tests.expect: No projection, supervised-learning, or type-center inference is introduced.
